studio.phoneWarning: There is a phone number in this draft. A number in the copy bypasses lead capture and the response SLA — the link already routes the client to you.

studio.brochureHelp: A one-page brochure with the gallery, specs and your contact — open it and use Print / Save as PDF.

adminIdentity.title: Group identity
adminIdentity.intro: Whether the operating group's branding is shown across the marketplace and the agent app. Held back at launch so the platform is judged on its own; switch it on once there are enough users for the affiliation to add weight rather than carry the whole proposition.
adminIdentity.activateHelp: Turns the branding on everywhere at once — logos, agency names beside agents, and the copy that names the group.
adminIdentity.hideHelp: Returns both apps to neutral branding. Note that anything already seen by visitors cannot be unseen.
adminIdentity.confirmActivate: Show the group identity on the public marketplace and to every agent? This is visible immediately to everyone.
adminIdentity.confirmHide: Return both apps to neutral branding?

state.hiddenTitle: Neutral — the group identity is hidden

state.publicTitle: Live — the group identity is public

affects.title: What this changes
affects.logos: The logo lock-up in the agent app, sign-in and shared links — the text wordmark is used instead.
affects.agency: The agency name shown beside an agent on public listings and property pages.
affects.copy: Copy in the agent app that names the group, on the wanted board and the plan label.

unaffected.title: What this does NOT change
unaffected.legal: Legal content. Terms, privacy and company details in Legal content keep naming the operating entity — who runs a service is a disclosure obligation, not a marketing choice.
unaffected.data: Nothing about the data. No listing, agent record or commission term is altered or hidden.
unaffected.agents: What agents can do. Verification, permissions and every module work exactly the same either way.

done.activated: The group identity is now public across both apps.
done.hidden: Both apps are back to neutral branding.

adminAi.title: AI console
adminAi.intro: Every AI call on the platform goes through one engine: it checks the agent’s allowance and the platform caps first, calls the provider a row in this table names, and writes one ledger line whatever happened. Nothing here is a constant in the code.
adminAi.keysHint: Set as Worker secrets (or .env.local in development). A feature routed to a provider without a key is recorded as “no provider” and the deterministic path answers.
adminAi.byFeatureHint: Where the money goes, and what fails.
adminAi.modelsHint: Provider and model per feature. Premium features are credit-metered separately; standard ones draw on the monthly allowance.
adminAi.settingsHint: Spend is in micro-USD (1,000,000 = US$1). The breaker opens for 10 minutes after consecutive provider errors and degrades every feature to its rules-only path.
adminAi.rolesHint: The 36 roles agents browse. A role is live only once its capability ships; flipping it here is what publishes it.
adminAi.recentHint: The ledger holds references and hashes, never the text.
adminAi.personasHint: Every role has a character: name, portrait, persona and strengths (from the six character sheets). Type a name under a country to give that market its own character; leave it empty to use the default.
adminAi.knowledgeHint: Seeded as draft (00098). Agents see the draft label until you mark a row verified. Retired rows disappear from agents.

aiWorkforce.title: AI Workforce
aiWorkforce.intro: Your AI colleagues. Each one works inside a screen you already use — it drafts, ranks and reminds; you decide and send.
aiWorkforce.liveCount: {count, plural, =0 {None live yet} one {1 live} other {# live}}
aiWorkforce.quota: {remaining} of {total} AI tasks left this month
aiWorkforce.verifyFirst: AI roles start working once your account is verified.
aiWorkforce.meet: Meet your AI colleagues — each has a name, a face and three strengths.
aiWorkforce.statusNote: Status shows what is open to you now. A portrait does not make a colleague live: only roles marked Live open a working screen.
aiWorkforce.catalogueNote: {count} roles in the catalogue. Rule-based tools run without AI keys. Model-powered features run only when AI is enabled for your account, and nothing on this page is verified as working end to end.

ai_manager.what: Reads your live numbers each morning and ranks what to do first. When AI is on, adds one short paragraph; otherwise the ranked list stands on its own.
ai_manager.gives: A ranked to-do list with links, and a one-line source label.
ai_manager.limits: Never sends anything. Rewriting the brief uses one AI task.
ai_manager.engine: Rule-based and tested. AI adds to it only when AI is enabled for your account; the AI path is not yet verified.

lead_qualifier.what: Scores each enquiry 1–5 from what the enquirer wrote and asked, with the reason in plain words, so you reply to the hottest first.
lead_qualifier.needs: The enquiry message and the listing it is about.
lead_qualifier.gives: A score, the reason, the signals and a suggested next step.
lead_qualifier.limits: Sorts, never hides. Re-scoring with AI uses one task.
lead_qualifier.engine: Rule-based and tested. AI adds to it only when AI is enabled for your account; the AI path is not yet verified.

property_matcher.what: Finds up to three other properties for an enquiry, from your own listings and the open co-marketing pool in the same country, with the reasons they fit.
property_matcher.gives: Up to three matches with price, area and a reason each.
property_matcher.limits: Suggests only. Sending them to the client is your call.
property_matcher.engine: Rule-based and tested. No AI model is used.

reply_drafter.what: Drafts a friendly, professional reply to an enquiry in the enquirer's language, for WhatsApp or e-mail, ready for you to edit and send.
reply_drafter.gives: A reply, a next step and questions worth asking.
reply_drafter.limits: Never sends on its own. Quotes only the price you listed. One AI task per AI draft.
reply_drafter.engine: Rule-based and tested. AI adds to it only when AI is enabled for your account; the AI path is not yet verified.

listing_copywriter.what: Turns the facts you have typed into a listing title and description, with selling points, for you to edit before you save.
listing_copywriter.needs: The listing form: type, location, rooms, sizes, price.
listing_copywriter.gives: Up to three titles, a description, selling points and notes.
listing_copywriter.limits: Drafts into the form; you save. Quotes only comparables the catalogue has.
listing_copywriter.engine: Rule-based; the writer is covered by a structural test only. AI adds to it only when AI is enabled; the AI path is not yet verified.

task_planner.what: Turns an enquiry or today's brief into a short task list with due times. You tick the ones you want and they are saved.
task_planner.gives: Up to five proposed tasks with kind and due time.
task_planner.limits: Proposes only; nothing is saved until you tick it.
task_planner.engine: Rule-based and tested. AI adds to it only when AI is enabled for your account; the AI path is not yet verified.

aiOffice.title: Watch your AI team working
aiOffice.intro: Twelve departments, one character per specialist. Every state you see comes from your own job and task records — nothing here is invented.
aiOffice.demoBanner: DEMO MODE — the activity below is simulated for demonstration. It is not your real AI work and nothing is saved.
aiOffice.truth: Jobs are recorded after a tool runs, so no character is ever shown “working right now” from job data. Celebrations mean a job finished in the last five minutes; “needs you” means a proposed task is waiting in your task list.
aiOffice.offlineNotice: Your account is not verified yet, so the office is offline. Complete verification to put your team to work.
aiOffice.mobileHint: Tap a specialist to inspect their work. The animated floor is shown on tablets and desktops.

stateHint.active: At least one job ran today for this specialist’s engine.
stateHint.finished: A job finished within the last five minutes.
stateHint.attention: This specialist proposed work that is waiting for your decision.
stateHint.idle: Available now; nothing has been asked today.
stateHint.error: The most recent run ended in an error. Try again from the tool’s screen.
stateHint.planned: The screen for this role does not exist yet. It never does real work.
stateHint.offline: Verify your account to open this role.

access.hero: Lives in AG Hero (link your account)

research.title: Listing Researcher
research.intro: Comparable published listings and their asking prices around a search — the same public facts a buyer sees, gathered in one place.
research.none: No published listings match this search yet.

outreach.title: Owner Outreach Drafter
outreach.intro: The first message to an owner who may want to sell or let. Respectful, specific, one easy next step — you send it from your own phone.
outreach.propertyHint: e.g. 3-bedroom terrace on Jalan Melati, corner lot, for-sale sign up since June
outreach.source: How you came across the owner
outreach.sourceHint: e.g. expired listing, a sign, a neighbour’s referral
outreach.offerHint: e.g. two buyers looking in this street; a free valuation
outreach.subject: Subject
outreach.followUp: If there is no reply in a week
outreach.phoneHint: Only to open WhatsApp — never stored
outreach.notStored: Nothing you type here is saved. The owner becomes a contact only when you add them yourself.

documents.title: Document Summariser
documents.intro: Upload a long document — a tenancy agreement, a sale and purchase agreement, a strata notice — and read the gist in your language. You verify anything legal or financial.
documents.uploadHint: PDF, photo or .txt, up to 8 MB
documents.verify: Verify with a lawyer or the owner
documents.unreadable: The document could not be read well — the summary may be incomplete.
documents.transient: The file is read and dropped. Nothing is stored except the AI ledger entry (no content).
documents.disclaimer: A summary, not advice. Legal and financial terms must be confirmed with a qualified professional.

errors.unsupported: That file type is not supported. Use a PDF, a photo or a text file.
errors.too_large: The file is too large — up to 8 MB.
errors.empty: Upload a document or paste its text first.

crossborder.title: Cross-border Researcher
crossborder.intro: What a buyer from the other market needs to know before they enquire — from the platform’s market facts, tailored to one listing. Draft facts are shown as draft until an admin verifies them.
crossborder.draftBanner: Some of these facts have not been verified yet. Treat them as a starting point and confirm before you quote them to a client.
crossborder.headline: In short

coach.title: Coach
coach.intro: Practise the conversation before you have it. Bring an objection a client raised, or answer a scenario and get honest feedback.
coach.objectionHint: e.g. “It’s too expensive for this area.”
coach.replyHint: Write what you would actually say
coach.heroHint: You are linked to AG Hero — the full Sales Lab and AI Coach are there too.

examples.wait: I’ll wait for prices to drop.

closing.title: Closing Checklist
closing.intro: The documents and steps between an accepted offer and the keys, for this country and this kind of deal. Start one per deal and tick as you go.
closing.pickOne: Pick a checklist on the left, or start one.
closing.draftBanner: Some steps are still draft — an admin has not verified them yet. Use them as a guide, not as legal advice.

errors.save_failed: That did not save. Please try again.

review.title: Performance Reviewer
review.intro: Your last seven days against the seven before — your own past first. Peers appear only as anonymised medians, and only when at least five were active.
review.verifyFirst: The weekly review starts once your account is verified.
review.numbersOnly: The numbers are below. The written insight needs an AI task.
review.peersNote: Medians across {count} active agents. Nobody is named.
review.peersFew: Not enough active peers this week for a fair comparison.

partners.title: Partner Finder
partners.intro: Verified agents in the other market who work the same property categories as you — for cross-border referrals and co-broke. Only what their public profile shows.
partners.noCategories: Add your property categories to your profile so partners can be matched to you.
partners.empty: No matching agents in the other market yet.
partners.poolOffers: {count, plural, one {# pool offer} other {# pool offers}}
partners.privacy: Contact goes through the public card. No phone numbers are shown here.

plan.title: Social Calendar Planner
plan.intro: A week of posts across your listings — one a day, rotating listings and platforms, a different angle each day. Edit, keep what you like, schedule through the Studio.
plan.empty: You need at least one published listing to plan a week.
plan.noAccounts: No social account is connected, so posts can be copied but not scheduled.
plan.scheduledHint: Each kept post goes into your queue exactly as shown. Instagram posts need a cover photo.
plan.igNeedsImage: No cover photo — Instagram cannot publish this one.

errors.invalid: The plan could not be read. Plan the week again.
errors.nothing_scheduled: Nothing was scheduled — check the accounts, the times and the photos.

report.title: Owner Report Writer
report.intro: This listing’s period in numbers, written up as the update you send to the owner: what happened, what it means, what you will do next.
report.sendNote: Opens WhatsApp on your phone with the text — you pick the owner there. Nothing is sent by the platform.
report.priceChanges: {count, plural, one {# price change} other {# price changes}}

refresh.title: Refresh planner
refresh.hint: {count, plural, one {# listing needs} other {# listings need}} attention this week
refresh.stats: {views} views in 14 days · {inquiries} enquiries in 30 days

photos.title: Photo check
photos.hint: Duplicates and resolution are checked at once. “Check with AI” looks for blur, faces, number plates, documents and watermarks.
photos.noPhotos: This listing has no photos yet.
photos.bestCover: Photo {n} would make the best cover.

translate.done: Translated — review the fields, then save.
translate.hint: Shown to buyers who browse in this language. Review every number and name before saving.

steps.first_share: Share a listing from the Studio

profiler.title: Paste the chat, get the requirement
profiler.hint: Paste what the client wrote (WhatsApp, e-mail, notes). The fields below fill in with only what they actually said — check each one.
profiler.placeholder: e.g. “Looking for a 3-bedroom condo to rent in Mont Kiara, max RM4,500, fully furnished, moving in January.”
profiler.privacy: The chat is not stored. Names and phone numbers are removed before the AI sees it.
